prompt:
Practice nets on a dusty Indian maidan at dawn: a net cage, a set of stumps, a kit bag and a water bottle, a tree, long shadows and mist. Painted like a vintage Indian sports-magazine centre spread from the 1980s: deep outfield greens, chalk white and cherry red, dramatic angle, faded glossy print. Full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no people, no faces, no hands. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no badges, no religious symbols, no writing anywhere.
